format: review manifest, not a MetaMCP import payload
requirements: Attach the same single upstream to both namespaces.
Persist all 13 discovered tools before classification.
Set every listed read tool ACTIVE in zerobyte-read and INACTIVE in zerobyte-write.
Set every listed write tool INACTIVE in zerobyte-read and ACTIVE in zerobyte-write.
Enable invocation filtering, not merely tools/list filtering.
Configure authenticated endpoints using the existing service-specific pattern.
Test direct known write tool names through the read endpoint are denied without executing a real write.
Test whether read credentials can reach the write endpoint; distinct key names do not prove endpoint-scoped authorization.
Re-review the complete catalog and mappings before every wrapper upgrade. Unknown/unmapped tools can be allowed by this MetaMCP filter.
